references.text: Instructions for making objects of beaten silver and gold for the sanctuary, using similar craftsmanship techniques as the trumpets
The sound of the horn (shofar) used to gather the people at Mount Sinai
Priests use the trumpets in war, which was one of the functions mentioned in the context
Priests blow horns at the conquest of Jericho to gather and lead the people
Priests blow trumpets in battle, as described in Numbers
Levites with trumpets in temple service during Hezekiah's time
Priests with trumpets at the founding of the second temple
The trumpet is blown at new moons and festivals to gather the congregation
The trumpet is sounded on Zion to gather the people and announce the day of the Lord
God's trumpet will sound at the return of the Lord to gather the believers
The last trumpet will sound at the resurrection, an eschatological gathering of God's people
